newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yields mixed at latest Saudi treasury bill offer.
newsitem.headline: Yields mixed at latest Saudi treasury bill offer.

text.p: Yields were mixed at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills, bankers said.
The yield on 28-day bills climbed to 5.6750 percent from 5.6497 last week and the rate on 91-day bills rose to 5.7936 from 5.7777 percent.
The 182-day bills were unchanged at 5.9453 percent and the rate on 364-day bills was also steady at 6.2342 percent.

One-month interbank deposit rates were quoted at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent and three month funds were at 5-15/16, 13/16. Six-month deposits were 6-1/16, 5-15/16 and one year interbank rates were at 6-3/8, 1/4 percent.
The bills were priced at 99.56055, 98.55664, 97.08203 and 94.07031 respectively.
